integrity: Analytic matrix and Gaussian arguments checked symbolically, with 77 deterministic independent computation assertions. Prior Gaussian-process results are cited; originality requires outside scholarly priority review. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The observable uses deterministic drift only, not stochastic pathwise angular velocity; requires a stable planar linear drift, stationary Gaussian initialization and strictly positive diffusion. Scalar drift gives identically zero activity. No finite-sample guarantees or experimental validation.
title: Universal drift-orbital memory and the node–focus sign boundary in planar Gaussian transport
